headlines.title: DoorDash (DASH) Becomes Official On Demand Delivery Partner Across North America
headlines.summary: DoorDash (NasdaqGS:DASH) has been named the Official On Demand Delivery and Pick Up Partner of the NHL across North America. The multiyear agreement covers both the United States and Canada and includes exclusivity within the on demand delivery category. DoorDash branding will appear during nationally televised NHL games, major league events and across league digital platforms throughout the season.

headlines.title: DoorDash (DASH) Stock May Look Overvalued Despite Fresh Campus Dining Deal
headlines.summary: DoorDash has seen its share price swing sharply in recent years, which puts fresh focus on whether the current market value lines up with what its earnings can reasonably support. With new partnerships reshaping how the business might generate and deploy profit over time, the key issue for readers is how much of that is already baked into the stock. Over the past 3 years, DoorDash has delivered a gain of 153.

description: DoorDash, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a commerce platform that connects merchants, consumers, and dashers in the United States and internationally. The company operates DoorDash Marketplace, Wolt Marketplace, and Deliveroo Marketplace, which provide various services, such as customer acquisition, demand generation, order fulfillment, merchandising, payment processing, and customer support. It also offers consumer membership programs, DashPass, Wolt+, and Deliveroo Plus; advertising as a value-added service through its marketplaces; and white-label delivery fulfillment services, as well as services that help merchants establish online ordering, build branded mobile apps, manage reservations and in-store dining, manage consumer relationships, enable tableside order and pay, and improve customer support. The company was formerly known as Palo Alto Delivery Inc. and changed its name to DoorDash, Inc. in 2015. DoorDash, Inc. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
